name: Store Locator
summary: General branch discovery through manual search, optional explicit geolocation and synchronized map, complete list results, details, contact, and target-owned directions without commerce selection.

anatomy.description: General location-discovery surface with no product or transaction requirement.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Visible heading and optional discovery explanation.

anatomy.name: heading

anatomy.name: searchForm

anatomy.description: Canonical visibly labelled manual location-search Input.

anatomy.name: useLocationAction

variants.name: default
variants.description: One searchable list-first branch discovery surface.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Intrinsic size with a private component-container stacking threshold.

states.name: ready
states.description: Complete target branch results are available.

states.name: loading
states.description: Target search is pending and stale results are suppressed.

states.name: empty
states.description: Completed search has no matching branches and manual search remains available.

states.name: error
states.description: Target search failed with truthful retry guidance and no stale results.

states.name: withMap
states.description: Optional synchronized map is present while the list remains complete.

behavior.name: manualSearch
behavior.description: Manual search remains available regardless of geolocation or map support. The target owns geocoding, requests, ordering, cancellation, retry, stale suppression, results, history, privacy, and analytics.

behavior.name: explicitGeolocation
behavior.description: Geolocation may be requested only after the explicit localized action; mounting or ordinary search interaction never prompts permission.

behavior.name: discoveryOnly
behavior.description: Store Locator discovers and inspects branches. It never chooses a transaction pickup location and never stores a temporary or account-level preferred branch.

behavior.name: directionsBoundary
behavior.description: Directions is an explicit canonical Link with target-owned destination, navigation, external-app policy, analytics, and failure handling.

behavior.name: resultLifecycle
behavior.description: The target location service owns provider truth, statuses, stale suppression, focus, and one concise announcement.

behavior.name: optionalMap
behavior.description: A capable target may add a synchronized map with its provider attribution and failure UI. Map absence or failure leaves every result, detail, contact, and direction link available in the list.

behavior.name: dependencyComposition
behavior.description: D9a consumes canonical Input, Button, and Link markup, focus, form, disabled, and navigation behavior without recreating their implementations.

accessibility: Use a visible heading to name the section and one visibly labelled canonical search Input; placeholder text never replaces either name.
Keep manual search available without geolocation or a map. Request device location only after the explicit localized Button action and provide target-owned privacy disclosure.
Render results as a native list of named branch articles with text-complete identity and address. Hours, services, contact, and directions omit cleanly when absent.
Use real descriptive canonical Links for phone and directions. Store Locator contains no transaction selection Radio, preferred-store control, or hidden account mutation.
Expose one coherent busy/result status and alert only new errors. Suppress stale result sets before publishing replacements.
The complete list remains usable under map failure, forced colors, zoom, text spacing, RTL, reduced motion, and narrow containers.

web.notes: Canonical Input/Button/Link composition, search states, native branch list, optional map slot, and container response are implemented; provider/geolocation/directions remain target-owned.

shopify.notes: Requires a target-native general-location data source, search/geocoding, localization, optional map provider, directions policy, schema/editor behavior, and live-store proof; product store availability is not a general locator source.

react.notes: Docs target demonstrates controlled query/result status and shared location-search renderer without making React canonical.
